name: PHARMA
recent: Pharmaniaga 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年大幅增长并宣布派发第三次中期股息 0.32 仙。公司同时出现董事局及审计与风险委员会成员变动，大股东 Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera 在 8 月至 9 月间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 0.32 仙。
2026 财年第三季度净利按年大幅增长，并计划在 2027 年推出九款新产品。
Dato' Seri Dr Hj Awaludin Bin Said 出现董事局、审计委员会及风险委员会职务变动。
risks: 大股东 Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera 在 8 月至 9 月间多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 1,041,034,000，按年增长 12.3%，按季下降 11.7%；净利为 MYR 12,493,000，按年增长 215.5%，按季下降 60.3%；净利率为 1.2%，低于上一季度的 2.7%。

recent_en: Pharmaniaga reported a sharp year-on-year rise in 3Q FY2026 net profit and declared a third interim dividend of 0.32 sen. The company also saw changes in its board and audit and risk committees, while substantial shareholder Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera filed multiple changes in its shareholding between August and September.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 0.32 sen per share.
3Q FY2026 net profit rose sharply year-on-year, with plans to launch nine new products in 2027.
Dato' Seri Dr Hj Awaludin Bin Said had changes in board, audit committee and risk committee roles.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Lembaga Tabung Angkatan Tentera filed multiple changes in its shareholding between August and September.
earnings_en: For 3Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was MYR 1,041,034,000, up 12.3% year-on-year and down 11.7% quarter-on-quarter; net income was MYR 12,493,000, up 215.5% year-on-year and down 60.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 1.2%, lower than 2.7% in the previous quarter.
